 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two panels on either side of a solid separator; mark overlap."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full, single-color divider row or column.
    divider = None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            divider = ("h", r)
            break
    if divider is None:
        for c in range(w):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
            if len(set(vals)) == 1:
                divider = ("v", c)
                break
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("No solid divider")
    orient, k = divider
    if orient == "h":
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        width = min(w, len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                 for j in range(width)] for i in range(n)]
    a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
    b = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
             for j in range(n)] for i in range(h)]
"
